evidence.title: Material Symbols and Icons - Google Fonts

name: Google Fonts
summary: Library for browsing font families, with the Material Symbols icon font and typography knowledge articles.
description: A browsable catalog of typefaces, presented as specimen pages, with families such as Aladin, Baloo Tamma 2, Chakra Petch, Grenze, Phudu and Taviraj. It also hosts Material Symbols — an icon font consolidating 2,500+ glyphs in a single file with a range of design variants — and Fonts Knowledge, typography guides and articles. The site renders client-side, so its pages return little text to crawlers.
